overview: The Commercial is a family-run inn on Market Square in St Just, with 11 en-suite bed and breakfast rooms and a self-catering cottage behind the pub. It serves lunch and evening meals and has a beer garden, and is close to Cape Cornwall, the South West Coast Path and Land's End.
surfTripFit: A practical, sociable base in St Just with food and Wi-Fi on site; Sennen and Gwynver are a short drive away, though no beach distance or surf facilities are stated.
gaps: Dog policy, inn parking, beach distance and board storage not stated.
